Module it.polimi.ingsw
Package it.polimi.ingsw.View.GUI

Class GameBoardController

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
it.polimi.ingsw.View.GUI.Gui
it.polimi.ingsw.View.GUI.GameBoardController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class GameBoardController extends Gui implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
Controller class for managing the game board GUI. This class handles the user interactions with the game board, updates the UI elements, and communicates with the server.
